en: Site report for {pname} on {date}: weather {weather}, {workers} workers on site, {hours_lost} hours lost. Work done: {work}.
Work on {pname} was stopped for {hours_lost} hours on {date} ({cause}). We keep the record for an extension of time.
Notice: {pname} lost {days_lost} days on {date} because of {cause}. The cost is {cost}. We ask you to confirm the extension of time.
Hello, the delay on {date} at {pname} ({cause}, {days_lost} days) is {state}. Please confirm that the finish date moves.
Hello, we sent a claim for {days_claimed} days on {pname}, value {value}. Please decide within the contract time.
Hello, our claim of {days_claimed} days on {pname} has waited {response} days for your decision. Can you answer this week?
Hi, the task "{task}" on {pname} starts on {start} for {days} working days. Please confirm the crew and the materials.
Hi, the task "{task}" on {pname} should have finished on {finish} and is {done} done, {days_late} days late. What do you need to catch up?
Hello, the milestone "{name}" on {pname} is planned for {planned}. A payment of {value} is expected on {pay_date}.
Hello, the milestone "{name}" on {pname} is {days_late} days past its date ({planned}). We are working to reach it and will confirm the new date.
Good news: the milestone "{name}" on {pname} is reached. Please certify it so that the payment of {value} can follow.
Hello, the inspection "{kind}" on {pname} is booked for {planned} with {authority}. Please keep the area clear.
Hello, the inspection "{kind}" on {pname} did not pass. We fix the points and book a new inspection. Current status: {state}.
Hi, please confirm {crew} workers for "{task}" on {date} at {pname}. We need your answer by tomorrow.
Hi, the job "{task}" on {date} is {state}: materials on site {materials}, plant booked {plant}. Please help us fix this before the date.
Hi, your action "{topic}" on {pname} is due on {due}. Please finish it and tell me.
Hi, your action "{topic}" on {pname} is {days_over} days overdue. Can you close it today?
Hello, our request "{subject}" on {pname} is due for an answer on {due}. It can delay the work by {impact_days} days.
Hello, our request "{subject}" on {pname} has been open {open_age} days. Please answer today so that work can continue.
Hello, the permit "{kind}" on {pname} ends on {expiry}, in {days_left} days. We are applying for the renewal.
Hello, drawing "{title}" on {pname} is now revision {rev}. Please use only this revision on site.
Hi, the task "{task_name}" on {pname} has {left} days of float left. Action: {action}, due {due}. Please confirm.
Hi, the setup item "{item}" on {pname} is {state}. It was due on {due}. Please close it before work starts.
Hi, in {month} you have {tasks_start} tasks starting and {act_due} actions due. {late_tasks} tasks are late and {over_actions} actions are overdue. Let us talk about priorities.
Notice of delay to the client
Notice of delay on {col:delays.pname}, sent by {set:firm} on {today}.
On {col:delays.date} the works lost {col:delays.days_lost} days. Cause: {col:delays.cause}. Note: {col:delays.note}.
The delay is carried by: {col:delays.party}. The cost of one day is {col:delays.day_cost} and the cost of this delay is {col:delays.cost}.
We ask you to confirm in writing that the completion date moves by the days that you carry.
Claim for an extension of time on {col:eot.pname}, sent by {set:firm} on {col:eot.submitted}.
The value of these days is {col:eot.value}. The claim has been open for {col:eot.response} days and the position is {col:eot.state}.
Please decide within {set:eot_days} days and confirm the new completion date.
Request for information on {col:rfi.pname}, sent by {set:firm} on {col:rfi.raised}.
We need your answer by {col:rfi.due}. Until then work may be delayed by up to {col:rfi.impact_days} days.
Please reply in writing with a drawing or an instruction.
Inspection request for {col:insp.pname}, sent by {set:firm} on {today}.
We ask {col:insp.authority} to carry out the inspection: {col:insp.kind}, planned for {col:insp.planned}.
The work is ready and the area is safe to enter. The inspection fee of {col:insp.fee} will be paid on the day.
Please confirm the date and the name of the inspector.
Monthly progress report to the client
Progress report on {col:projects.name} for {col:projects.client}, issued by {set:firm} on {today}.
Planned progress is {col:projects.plan} and actual progress is {col:projects.actual}. The value of work done is {col:projects.earned} of {col:projects.contract_value}.
The planned finish is {col:projects.finish}, which is {col:projects.days_left} days from today. The schedule flag is {col:projects.flag}.
We have logged {col:projects.delay_days} delay days and {col:projects.open_rfi} requests for information are still open.
Milestone notice for {col:ms.pname}, issued by {set:firm} on {today}.
The milestone "{col:ms.name}" was planned for {col:ms.planned}. Status: {col:ms.state}.
It releases {col:ms.pay_pct} of the contract, a value of {col:ms.value}. Payment is expected on {col:ms.pay_date}.
Please certify the milestone so that payment is made on time.
Permit renewal request for {col:pm.pname}, sent by {set:firm} on {today}.
The permit "{col:pm.kind}" issued by {col:pm.authority} expires on {col:pm.expiry}, in {col:pm.days_left} days.
We ask for a renewal before that date so that work can continue without a stop. The fee paid last time was {col:pm.fee}.
Please send the new permit to the site office.
Work instruction for {col:la.pname}, issued by {set:firm} on {today}.
To {col:la.sub}: please carry out "{col:la.task}" on {col:la.date} with a crew of {col:la.crew}.
Materials on site: {col:la.materials}. Plant booked: {col:la.plant}. The job is {col:la.state}.
Please confirm the crew and report any problem to the supervisor the day before.
Reminder of an open site action
Action reminder for {col:act.pname}, sent by {set:firm} on {today}.
At the meeting of {col:act.meeting} it was agreed that {col:act.owner} will do this: {col:act.topic}.
The due date was {col:act.due}. The priority is {col:act.priority} and the status is {col:act.state}.
Please finish the action and tell the project manager today.

Open Start and type your company name and your own rules in the yellow cells: warning days, the share behind plan that is late, the daily cost of a delay, working hours in a day and the days allowed for answers.
List every project on Projects with its client, manager, dates and contract value. Progress, delay days and the schedule flag fill in from the schedule and diary.
Build the schedule on Schedule: one row for each task with a start, working days and percent done. The finish, planned progress, days late and status fill in.
Add the payment milestones on Milestones. Each one shows its payment value and the date the money should arrive.
Write the site diary every working day: weather, workers, hours lost, the cause and the work done. Month, labour cost and the type of day fill in.
Log each delay on Delays and each claim on Extension Claims. The cost of a day comes from the contract value and the claim position shows what you can ask from the client.
Watch Weather Days to see wet days against your normal allowance, counted from the diary.
Track Inspections, Permits, RFIs and Drawings so that nothing stops the work: due dates, expiry dates and response days are calculated.
Plan three weeks ahead on Look-ahead, with the crew and whether materials and plant are ready, and follow Meetings and Actions after every site meeting.
Keep Critical Tasks, Crew Plan, Photos, Visitors, Site Setup and Lessons up to date for the full picture of each project.

Use the 14 calculators for progress, days late, working days, extension of time, crew size, earned schedule, the look-ahead, delay cost, RFIs, weather, milestone payments, float, recovery and the diary.
Print 10 sheets and 9 letters, follow 10 step-by-step checklists and tap a message link to open WhatsApp with the text ready.
Read Projects Dashboard and Charts every week: late tasks, delays, claims, inspections, requests for information and permits.
Control budgets, change orders and margin on every project
Budgets, forecasts and change orders that protect margin
each budget line shows transfers, revised budget, cost to date, commitments, what is left and a warning before the money is gone
Actual cost lines by cost code
every invoice and payroll entry is booked to a project and cost code, so budgets, reports and forecasts all update
orders and subcontracts not yet invoiced are counted against the budget, with a warning when delivery is late
Cost to complete and forecast final cost
share of work done and cost still to come give the forecast final cost, variance and cost performance for every cost code
Change orders with price and chase
your cost with markup, days added and days waiting, with a warning to chase the client, and approved changes raise the contract value
forecast profit and margin for each project against the bid margin, month by month, so a fading margin is seen early
Monthly cost report for each project
value earned against cost booked gives gross profit and margin for every month with the cost to date
daywork valued with markups, allowances watched against spending and backcharges with fee and chase until recovered
what redoing work costs, which overruns have a cause and how much contingency is left on each project
Earned value and early warning calculators
cost and schedule indexes, burn ratio and break-even show a problem before the cost report does

Projects: contract value, budget, cost, forecast and margin
One row for each project with its contract value, bid margin and contingency; budget, cost to date, commitments, forecast cost, forecast margin and a health check fill in from the other sheets.
Cost codes: budget, cost and forecast, all projects
One row for each cost code; budget, cost to date, commitments, forecast final cost and the variance fill in across every project.
Project budgets by cost code against cost and commitments
One row for each project and cost code with its budget; transfers, revised budget, cost to date, commitments, what is left and a warning fill in.
Actual cost lines booked to project and cost code
One row for each cost booked: date, project, cost code, cost type, who was paid and the amount; project name and month fill in so every budget and report updates.
Committed costs: orders not yet invoiced
One row for each order or subcontract with its value and what has been invoiced; the open commitment, the project and a late delivery warning fill in.
Change orders: cost, price, days and decision
One row for each change with your cost and the days it needs; the price with your markup, margin, days waiting and a chase warning fill in, and approved changes raise the revised contract value.
Cost to complete by project and cost code
One row for each project and cost code: type the share of the work done and your estimate of the cost still to come; the forecast final cost, variance and cost performance fill in.
One row for each project and month: type the value earned in the month; the cost booked, the gross profit, the margin and the cost to date fill in from the cost lines.
Cost to date at month end
One row for each project: type the extra cost you expect but have not booked; the revised value, forecast final cost, forecast profit, margin and the gap to the bid margin fill in.
Provisional sums: allowance and what has been spent
One row for each provisional sum with its allowance and what you have spent; what is left, the share used and a warning fill in.
Daywork sheets: extra work paid by time and materials
One row for each daywork sheet with hours, rate, materials and plant; the value with your markups, the days waiting for a signature and a chase warning fill in.
Backcharges to subcontractors for defects, damage and delay
One row for each backcharge with the subcontractor, reason and amount; the fee, total, days open and a chase warning fill in.
Rework and waste log: what redoing work costs
One row for each piece of work done twice with the hours and extra material; the cost, the share you can recover and the project fill in.
One row for each cost code that is forecast to overrun: type the cause and how much of the overrun it explains; the overrun, the part still unexplained and a check fill in.
Contingency drawdown and why it was used
One row for each use of the contingency; the total drawn so far on the project, what is left and a warning fill in.
Drawn so far on the project
Overheads allocated to site cost by month
One row for each month: type the office overhead you carried; the direct cost, the overhead you recovered at your rate, the gap and the rate you needed fill in.
Value engineering ideas and the saving they bring
One row for each idea with its saving, its cost and its state; the net saving, the return and whether it is worth doing fill in.
Profit fade: forecast margin against the bid
One row for each project and month: type the margin you forecast that month; the bid margin, the fade in points and a warning fill in.
One row for each move of budget from one cost code to another; the project, the month and who must approve it fill in, and the budgets update by themselves.

Ask a client to approve a change
Hello, the change "{title}" on "{proj}" is priced at {price} and adds {days} days. Please approve it in writing so that we can proceed.
Hello, we are still waiting for your decision on "{title}" on "{proj}" ({price}). It has been {waiting} days. Please confirm today.
Ask for more time for a change
Hello, "{title}" on "{proj}" needs {days} extra days. We ask you to move the completion date by that time.
Thank a client for an approved change
Hello, thank you for approving "{title}" on "{proj}" at {price}. We will start now and update the programme.
Hello, we have not started "{title}" on "{proj}" because it is not approved yet. A delay in the decision may delay the project.
Ask a client to sign a daywork sheet
Hello, the daywork sheet {dw_id} for "{desc}" on "{proj}" is {value}. Please sign it so that we can invoice it.
Hello, the daywork sheet {dw_id} on "{proj}" has waited {wait} days for your signature. Please send it today.
Hello, about the daywork sheet {dw_id} on "{proj}": we can meet on site to go through the hours and the materials. Which day suits you?
Hello, we are sending you a backcharge of {total} for {reason} on "{proj}". Please read the notice and answer within seven days.
Hello, the backcharge of {total} on "{proj}" is open for {age} days. Please confirm that we may deduct it from your next payment.
Hello, we deducted the backcharge of {total} on "{proj}" from your latest payment. Thank you for your cooperation.
Confirm an order and its date
Hello, please confirm the order {po_id} for "{proj}" at {value} and the delivery by {due}.
Hello, the order {po_id} for "{proj}" was due on {due} and is still open. Please tell us today when it arrives.
Ask for the invoice of an order
Hello, please send the invoice for order {po_id} on "{proj}". We still show {open} as not invoiced.
Warn a manager of a margin at risk
Hello, "{name}" shows a forecast margin of {margin_pct} against a bid margin of {bid_margin}. Please send your plan to protect it this week.
Ask a manager for the cost to complete
Hello, please update the share of work done and the cost still to come for "{name}" before the cost review.
Hello, the contingency left on "{name}" is {cont_left}. Please tell us which risks it still has to cover.
Remind a manager of the month-end report
Hello, please send the value earned and book all commitments for "{name}" so that the monthly cost report can close.
Tell a client a sum is used up
Hello, the provisional sum "{item}" on "{proj}" is {used} used. We will send the price of the rest before we order.
Say a provisional sum is over
Hello, the cost of "{item}" on "{proj}" is above the allowance of {allowance}. Please confirm the extra cost before we continue.
Hello, rework on "{proj}" cost {cost} ({cause}). Please check the cause with the crew and tell us what changes.
Ask a manager to claim a cost
Hello, the rework on "{proj}" can be recovered for {recoverable}. Please send the notice to the party responsible.
Ask a manager to explain an overrun
Hello, "{proj}" is forecast to overrun by {overrun} on one cost code and {unexplained} has no reason yet. Please add the cause.
Tell a manager about a contingency draw
Hello, {amount} was drawn from the contingency of "{proj}". {left} is left. Please confirm the reason.
Ask for approval of a transfer
Hello, a budget transfer of {amount} on "{proj}" needs approval: {state}. Reason: {reason}.
Ask for the next step on a saving idea
Hello, the idea "{idea}" on "{proj}" can save {net} net. Please tell us if we may go ahead.
Warn a manager about profit fade
Hello, the forecast margin on "{proj}" is now {fcst}, a change of {fade} from the bid. Please review the costs this week.
Change order price sent to the client
We priced this change at {col:changes.price}, which adds {col:changes.days} days to the programme. Please confirm in writing that we may proceed.
We will not start this work until you confirm, so that the price and the time are agreed before any cost is spent.
